title: UN Envoy Grundberg Warns of Escalation After Houthi Red Sea Tanker Strikes, Calls for Talks
detail: July 24, 2026 — After Houthi forces resumed Red Sea attacks on tankers Encelia and Layla (July 22), following a July 20 blockade threat, UN Special Envoy for Yemen Hans Grundberg warned that 'escalatory actions risk putting Yemen on a path toward further confrontation' and urged an urgent return to negotiations. Brent crude rose above $100 a barrel on the news, reflecting the wider economic stakes of the fraying 2022 UN truce framework.
